summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Integrated Media, Messaging, and Public Engagement Strategies. Master techniques to elevate your communication efforts
lede: Press engagement training helps communications and public affairs professionals coordinate media relations, messaging, and stakeholder participation. Participants use the PESO Model and RACE Framework to shape audience-focused campaign plans, build message houses, and design public participation; they also plan media responses and track communication results through listening and evaluation. It suits practitioners who contribute to communications activity and need a more integrated approach to planning and measurement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate communication channels, public narratives, media relationships, and stakeholder participation. It suits intermediate practitioners who already contribute to communications activity and advanced professionals who need a more integrated planning and measurement approach.
prerequisites: You need practical exposure to at least one communication function, such as media relations, content planning, public consultation, social media, internal communications, or campaign coordination. You do not need programming skills. Familiarity with spreadsheets and access to a laptop will support dashboard and planning exercises. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted listening and sentiment analysis remain at operational application level, with configuration demonstrations rather than technical engineering.
